entries.zh: 领兵；接收、征集兵员并加统率
entries.en: to receive or muster soldiers; to take troops into service and lead them

entries.zh: 粮户：缴纳实物贡赋的纳税户；encomendero（受封征收贡赋的西班牙领主）向其征赋
entries.en: the tribute household (grain and household) from which the encomendero collects tribute
to receive a favour; to be granted grace
to receive bribes; to take bribes covertly
entries.notes: L 栏 cohechos（贿赂）义明；H 栏末字残缺、中段字与 M 对不上，故取西语义为主，汉字仅作参证。

entries.zh: 事后承接；接手他人既已办成之事
entries.en: to receive something after it has been done; to take it over at second hand
entries.notes: L 栏缩写 afs.、venel offi. 残缺难确解，义依 H 承下手 与「después de hecho」。

entries.zh: 收定；收取定金作为凭信
entries.en: to take as a token or earnest (señal)

entries.zh: 暂屈；暂且忍受屈辱（受屈）
entries.en: to bear affronts for a while; to put up with injury briefly
to give and receive; mutual exchange
entries.notes: L 栏标[疑]（疑读 recibir los indios），与 H 授受 不相应，释义从 H、M。

entries.en: to receive a bestowal; to accept gifts
entries.notes: L 栏后段[残]（recivir dadivas…），H 受赐 与 M 相合，义尚可定。

entries.zh: 相互的；互相（「相」字，表交互）
诱鸟；以媒鸟或哨声招引小鸟
entries.en: a decoy call for a little bird; to lure a bird with a decoy
entries.notes: L 栏中段[残]；H「烏四」末字与 M 不合，疑当作「母」，义依 reclamo 的诱鸟义与 pajarillo 定。

entries.en: the decoy bird itself, a small bird kept as a lure
entries.notes: H 末字与 M 不合，疑为「母」（鳥母＝雌鸟、媒鸟）；义依 L「este pajarillo」。

entries.en: to lean; to lean oneself up on the arm
entries.notes: L「subirse al braço」语意含混，M 栏有缩写残形，释义只取「靠、倚」。

entries.en: to gather up; to collect or clear away (in a place)

entries.zh: 收脚；收敛退步、改过自新
entries.en: to draw back and mend one's ways; to reform

entries.zh: 收拢额前头发；挽起鬓发
entries.en: to gather up the hair from the forehead
entries.notes: H 栏[残]，第二字难辨（M 作 gui），义依 L 全句。
